title.narrative: The 4th National Plan of Action for Children was finalized with the support of UNICEF. Key milestones included Government commitment to implement the Child Protection Systems Strengthening Strategy, updated child abuse cases protocols, enhanced child protection in emergencies, and strengthened inter-agency coordination for children in conflict situations.

Extent to which UNICEF advocacy action contributed to progress on laws, regulations, policies, budgets, or practices related to the UNICEF Global Advocacy Priority on mental health of children and young people, and to bring an end to neglect, abuse and childhood traumas
Level of development of quality assurance system for social service workforce

Extent to which policies, programmes and mechanisms for prevention of family separation and promotion of family-based alternative care are in line with the 2009 Guidelines for the Alternative Care of Children
Phase of maturity of the child protection systems
Extent of legal prohibition of corporal punishment of children in all settings
Quality of the system to document, analyse and use data about grave child-rights violations/other serious rights violations for prevention and response
Extent of development of specialized justice for children systems
Extent of alignment of national legislation with international standards regarding the criminalization of child sexual abuse and exploitation and protection of child victims
Extent to which the country has a national legislation to eliminate the worst forms of child labour
Availability of CP case management and referral systems, Text
